summary: Independent review of all 383 Chinese units in Nan Qishu treatise on celestial omens (juan 12). Song Shengming 3 (AD 479) memorial chain, Yongtai and Yongyuan rebellion/execution linkages, and Chunqiu Lu Huan year 3 eclipse citation are source-supported with correct event ownership. Jianwu-era claims for Emperor Ming encode an explicit Western interval ending AD 497 that is one year short of the orthodox Jianwu close (AD 498). Huang Xiang, Zheng Xuan, and Wang Yi retrospective quotations are correctly modeled as quoted-authority events but still carry attestation westernBounds/interval and matching hints without chapter witnesses. No diagnostics unresolved flags remain after review.

itemChecks.event: Taizu received the revolutionary transfer of power at the end of Liu Song (political reception of mandate).
itemChecks.reason: s0005–s0006 place the Taizu revolution reception in the Song Shengming 3 memorial frame; 宋昇明三年 converts to AD 479 under Liu Song reign dating and belongs to the mandate-transfer narrative, not a retrospective gloss.

itemChecks.event: Taizu’s power transfer contextualized by the Song Shengming 3 astronomical memorial sequence.
itemChecks.reason: Explicit attestation matches s0006 regnal heading 宋昇明三年 with Taizu context in s0005; Western year AD 479 follows the stated Song reign year.

itemChecks.event: Wen Xiaojian held the office of Director of Astronomy (太史令) when memorializing in Song Shengming 3.
itemChecks.reason: 太史令 appears in s0006 dated 宋昇明三年; office holding at memorial time is directly witnessed.

itemChecks.event: Wen Xiaojian concurrently held Master of Works (將作匠) in Song Shengming 3.
itemChecks.reason: 將作匠 is listed with the same Shengming 3 dateline in s0006; concurrent office holding is textually explicit.

itemChecks.event: Wen Xiaojian served the Song polity when submitting the Shengming 3 celestial memorial.
itemChecks.reason: Memorial occurs under Song in Shengming 3 per s0006; polity association is co-temporal with the dated memorial.

itemChecks.event: Wen Xiaojian authored the quoted memorial on eclipses and planetary phenomena.
itemChecks.reason: Memorial author role is explicit in 文孝建陳天文 with extended quotation through s0054; attribution is source-quoted.

itemChecks.event: Wen Xiaojian presented the celestial-omens memorial to the throne in Song Shengming 3.
itemChecks.reason: 文孝建 presented celestial omens in Shengming 3 per s0006 opening clause; event ownership and year match the Chinese.

itemChecks.event: Composite attestation of Wen Xiaojian’s Shengming 3 memorial in both astronomical offices.
itemChecks.reason: Composite attestation accurately summarizes dual offices and Shengming 3 dating on s0006.

itemChecks.event: Southern Qi polity rule attributed to Emperor Ming during the Jianwu era window.
itemChecks.reason: The source dates Emperor Ming’s secrecy policy to 建武世 without giving Western endpoints. Encoding AD 494–497 as an explicit ruled interval understates the Jianwu era, which runs through 498 in standard Southern Qi reign dating; the end year should be 498 or the interval left source-bounded.

itemChecks.event: Emperor Ming suppressed outward reporting of Grand Astrologer memorials in the Jianwu period.
itemChecks.reason: s0056 witnesses Ming Emperor’s suppression during 建武世 only. The event is supported, but the paired Western interval end AD 497 is one year short of the orthodox Jianwu close (498); do not treat AD 497 as textually derived.

itemChecks.event: Attestation of Ming Emperor’s Jianwu-era suppression of celestial reports.
itemChecks.reason: Attestation duplicates the Jianwu-era suppression with explicit WesternInterval 494–497; Chinese gives era name only, and the closing Western year 497 conflicts with standard Jianwu AD 498 endpoint.

itemChecks.event: Wang Jingze raised troops three days after the Yongtai 1 fourth-month guihai lunar eclipse.
itemChecks.reason: s0073–s0074 tie 永泰元年四月癸亥 eclipse to rebellion 三日而大司馬王敬則舉兵; Yongtai 1 is AD 498 under Southern Qi.

itemChecks.event: Attestation dating Wang Jingze’s rebellion to Yongtai 1 AD 498.
itemChecks.reason: Attestation restates s0073–s0074 linkage of Yongtai eclipse and Wang Jingze uprising with correct regnal year conversion.

itemChecks.event: Xiao Yaoguang was executed by night following the Yongyuan 1 eighth-month eclipse.
itemChecks.reason: s0075–s0076 place 始安王遙光伏誅 on the Yongyuan 1 eighth-month jiwei eclipse night; death date is explicit.

itemChecks.event: Legal action: Xiao Yaoguang suffered execution (伏誅) on the eclipse night.
itemChecks.reason: 伏誅 on the same night as s0076 witnesses; legal action is co-dated with eclipse record.

itemChecks.event: Event participation: Xiao Yaoguang put to death on Yongyuan 1 jiwei night.
itemChecks.reason: Execution participation matches s0076 narrative timing on eclipse night.

itemChecks.event: Attestation of Xiao Yaoguang’s execution tied to Yongyuan 1 eclipse witnesses.
itemChecks.reason: Attestation accurately binds execution to Yongyuan 1 jiwei eclipse witnesses in s0075–s0076.

itemChecks.event: Huang Xiang quoted as retrospective Han authority on eclipse direction (undated quotation).
itemChecks.reason: event-participation uses retrospective-reference kind for 黃香曰; no life-date predicate error and quotation is undated retrospective reception.

itemChecks.event: Attestation placing Huang Xiang in Eastern Han bounds on an undated quotation.
itemChecks.reason: s0087 quotes Huang Xiang’s doctrine without calendar date. An attestation with explicit Western bounds encodes Eastern Han dynasty limits as if witnessed here; that is outside-sourced biographical framing on a retrospective quotation, not life activity dated by this chapter.

itemChecks.event: Duke Huan of Lu year 3 solar eclipse cited from Chunqiu (魯桓三年).
itemChecks.reason: 魯桓三年 in s0088 is the Chunqiu regnal year of the cited eclipse; BC 709 is the standard conversion for Lu Duke Huan year 3, describing the eclipse year not Nan Qi compilation.

itemChecks.event: Zheng Xuan quoted retrospectively explaining central solar eclipse wording.
itemChecks.reason: 鄭玄云 in s0090 is retrospective scholarly citation; kind retrospective-reference avoids treating the remark as a dated life event.

itemChecks.event: Attestation with Western lifespan interval on Zheng Xuan’s undated scholarly comment.
itemChecks.reason: s0090 cites 鄭玄云 with no 干支 or reign. westernInterval AD 127–200 imports biography; the chapter only retrospectives his exegetical remark and must not carry explicit lifespan precision on an attestation predicate.

itemChecks.event: Wang Yi quoted retrospectively objecting to lunar-masking eclipse explanation.
itemChecks.reason: 王逸以爲 in s0091–s0092 is correctly modeled as retrospective quotation without invented event dating.

itemChecks.event: Attestation with Western bounds on Wang Yi’s undated scholarly objection.
itemChecks.reason: s0091–s0092 record 王逸以爲 without dating. westernBounds circa AD 100–200 are glossary biography, not derivable from the Nan Qi astronomy treatise witness.

itemChecks.event: Active-date hint AD 479 from Song Shengming 3 political astronomy narrative.
itemChecks.reason: Chapter anchors Taizu narrative at 宋昇明三年 (AD 479); hint matches witnessed political astronomy frame.

itemChecks.event: Active-date hint AD 479 anchored to Wen Xiaojian’s Shengming 3 memorial.
itemChecks.reason: Wen Xiaojian’s only dated appearance is Shengming 3; AD 479 hint is source-supported.

itemChecks.event: Active-date hint AD 494–497 for Emperor Ming Jianwu-era activity.
itemChecks.reason: Hint AD 494–497 mirrors the incorrect Jianwu interval terminus; chapter text does not state AD 497.

itemChecks.event: Active-date hint AD 498 for Wang Jingze’s Yongtai rebellion.
itemChecks.reason: Wang Jingze rebellion is dated Yongtai 1 in s0073–s0074 (AD 498).

itemChecks.event: Active-date hint AD 499 for Xiao Yaoguang’s Yongyuan execution.
itemChecks.reason: Xiao Yaoguang execution night is Yongyuan 1 in s0075–s0076 (AD 499).

itemChecks.event: Active-date hint Eastern Han span for Huang Xiang quotation.
itemChecks.reason: Hint Eastern Han AD 25–220 propagates unsupported bounds from claim-39; quotation unit lacks calendrical life dating.

itemChecks.event: Active-date hint BC 709 for Lu Huan year 3 eclipse citation.
itemChecks.reason: Lu Huan year 3 eclipse citation supports BC 709 as the Spring and Autumn year of the event.

itemChecks.event: Active-date hint AD 127–200 for Zheng Xuan quotation.
itemChecks.reason: Hint duplicates unsourced Zheng Xuan lifespan window not present in s0090.

itemChecks.event: Active-date hint second-century AD span for Wang Yi quotation.
itemChecks.reason: Hint duplicates unsourced Wang Yi century bounds not present in s0091–s0092.

personChecks.reason: Taizu’s mandate reception and Shengming 3 framing are witnessed without omitted personal chronology in this astronomy chapter.
Wen Xiaojian’s offices and memorial are explicitly dated Shengming 3; no missing birth or death claims appear in the chapter.
Emperor Ming’s Jianwu policy is witnessed, but extraction encodes an incorrect Western interval terminus (AD 497 vs orthodox 498 close).
Wang Jingze rebellion dating follows Yongtai 1 eclipse linkage in s0073–s0074.
Xiao Yaoguang execution is explicitly dated to Yongyuan 1 eclipse night.
Quoted Huang Xiang carries unsupported Eastern Han bounds on attestation and hints; quotation itself is valid retrospective reception.
Lu Duke Huan year 3 eclipse year is the sole dated mention; conversion BC 709 is appropriate to the cited regnal year.
Zheng Xuan appears only as undated retrospective authority; explicit lifespan interval on attestation is unsupported.
Wang Yi appears only as undated retrospective authority; Western bounds on attestation duplicate unsupported biography.

findings.problem: Jianwu-era dating uses explicit Western interval 494–497 although Southern Qi Jianwu closes in AD 498 and the Chinese states only 建武世 without Western endpoints.
findings.action: Adjust westernInterval end to AD 498 or remove explicit Western endpoints and retain sourceDate 建武世 pending conversion policy.

findings.problem: Huang Xiang quotation is undated; attestation and hints attach Eastern Han Western bounds not stated in s0087.
findings.action: Retain retrospective-reference event participation only; strip attestation westernBounds and align hints to undated quotation or hash-pin external biography separately.

findings.problem: Zheng Xuan scholarly quote lacks calendrical language; attestation westernInterval and hint import biography.
findings.action: Remove lifespan interval from attestation; keep claim-47 retrospective-reference; clear or unresolved hint until external source pinned.

findings.problem: Wang Yi objection is undated; westernBounds on attestation and second-century hint are outside this chapter.
findings.action: Drop attestation westernBounds; preserve claim-52 retrospective-reference; repair hints-p009 to undated or research-blocked.

findings.problem: Person-level checks inherit the incorrect Jianwu terminus or unsupported retrospective biography bounds.
findings.action: Reconcile after item repairs; person checks should return supported when explicit unsourced Western precision is removed.

references.quote: 建武世太史奏事，明帝不欲使天變外傳，竝祕而不出，自此闕焉。
references.reason: Witness for Jianwu-era suppression; confirms era name only without AD 497 language.

references.quote: 鄭玄云：「月正掩日，日光從四邊出，故言從中起也。」
references.reason: Undated retrospective quotation; no lifespan dates in primary text.
